title: Define the four-lens review and final approval workflow
description: Design built-in review expectations for people, reader agents, search crawlers and social previews. Determine what evidence, findings, unresolved risks and editorial judgment the final review presents, what happens when a lens cannot be assessed, and how this reaches all newsroom agents. Integrate existing context packs, mission and site-specific policy without requiring publications to restate universal defaults. Decide which checks are advisory or gates rather than assuming a new blocking gate.
